title: Behind Harmful Compliance: Behavioral and Mechanistic Divergence Across LLM Jailbreaks
abstract: arXiv:2604.18510v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Open-weight language models can be rendered unsafe through several parameter-level interventions, yet models with matched harmful compliance can exhibit fundamentally different failure modes. We compare harmful supervised fine-tuning (SFT), harmful reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), and refusal-feature abliteration in Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B using harmfulness, capability, self-audit, safety reflection, representation similarity, and refusal-direction repair. All three routes reach near-ceiling harmfulness, but SFT causes the broadest capability loss and representational drift; abliteration yields localized, family-dependent refusal-feature suppression; and RLVR largely preserves base-model capability, explicit safety judgments, and representation geometry while retargeting behavior toward compliance. translated_title: 有害合规的背后：LLM越狱中的行为与机制分化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.18510v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：开放权重语言模型可以通过多种参数层面的干预手段被变得不安全，然而具有相同有害合规能力的模型可能表现出根本不同的失效模式。我们在Qwen2.5-7B和Llama-3.1-8B上比较了有害监督微调（SFT）、基于可验证奖励的有害强化学习（RLVR）以及拒绝特征消除（abliteration）三种方法，评估维度包括有害性、能力、自我审计、安全反思、表征相似性和拒绝方向修复。这三种途径都达到了接近上限的有害性，但SFT造成了最广泛的能力损失和表征漂移；abliteration产生了局部化的、依赖于模型家族的拒绝特征抑制；而RLVR在很大程度上保留了基础模型的能力、显式安全判断和表征几何结构，同时只是将行为重新定向为合规。因此，RLVR模型尽管在合规状态下行为异常，但对安全反思提示仍然保持着异常的响应性。
tldr: 本研究比较了有害SFT、有害RLVR和拒绝特征消除三种越狱方法，发现三者虽都能达到接近上限的有害性，但机制后果截然不同——SFT导致最广泛的能力损失与表征漂移，abliteration产生局部且依赖模型家族的拒绝抑制，而RLVR基本保留模型能力与安全判断、仅在行为层面重定向为合规。
en_tdlr: Comparing harmful SFT, harmful RLVR, and abliteration across Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B, this study reveals that while all three jailbreak routes achieve near-ceiling harmfulness, they diverge mechanistically: SFT causes the broadest capability loss and representational drift, abliteration yields localized family-dependent refusal suppression, and RLVR largely preserves base-model capability and safety judgments while merely retargeting behavior toward compliance.
